analysis_framework.objective: Map natural language meta-persona instructions to explicit linear Steering Vector Fields (SVF) within the residual stream of a transformer architecture.
analysis_framework.methodology: Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) latent isolation combined with differentiable concept scoring for active inference steering.

sae_formulation.description: The training objective isolates "persona vectors" by minimizing the reconstruction error of the residual stream activations $\mathbf{x}$ while enforcing a strict TopK=64 sparsity constraint via the $L_1$ penalty term $\lambda \|\mathbf{f}(\mathbf{x})\|_1$. This forces the dictionary $\mathbf{D}$ to orthogonalize the "Assistant Axis" from specialized "Ontological Diplomat" features.

svf_differential_equations.description: The local gradient of the differentiable concept scoring function $S(\mathbf{x}_t)$ dictates the required activation shift. The Steering Vector Field (SVF) is defined by the gradient flow, moving the latent representation $\mathbf{x}_t$ toward the persona manifold without requiring parameter weight updates. Here, $\alpha$ is the steering magnitude.

thermodynamic_tax_model.description: Maintaining a 3-agent simulated Socratic council incurs a massive metabolic tax proportional to the context length $N$ squared per head, multiplied by three independent KV caches. "Epistemic Composting" structurally decays these non-essential social latents during pure causal inference tasks, recovering $\gamma$ fraction of attention bandwidth and memory by leveraging shift-invariance in the latent space.
